description: THE HOSTS' OWN EDIT. Call it when somebody asks to CHANGE a detail of a wedding or other personal event this connector serves ("move the ceremony to 4:30 PM", "change the dress code"). IT APPLIES THE CHANGE ON THIS CALL and the reply says the detail now and before: read both out. One `field` per call; a time needs am or pm. `undo: true` reverses the caller's own last change. Only the hosts can change it; read refusals (NOT_A_HOST, BAD_TIME, NO_SUCH_PLACE, NO_SUCH_ENTRY, NO_CHANGE) out as given and do not work around them; it sends no message and it changes nothing else on the event; the event's Wallet passes are updated with the new detail as a lock-screen notice and the reply's `passNotice` says how many passes were reached. It requires a personal connector token.

entryTitle.description: For schedule_time: the row title as spelled.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the hosts spell it.

field.description: ceremony_time, reception_time, ceremony_place, reception_place, dress_code, arrival_note, schedule_time or faq_answer; required unless `undo`.

undo.description: Optional; true reverses the caller's own last change.

value.description: The new value, as the hosts say it. No links or markup.

venueName.description: Optional venue name, for the place fields.

name: event_change_detail
title: Change one detail of a personal event (hosts only)
